overview.description: The Corgi NYC Based ETF (NYNY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund invests in companies significantly involved in the New York City metropolitan operating and business ecosystem. The actively managed portfolio may include companies from different sectors and various market capitalization. NYNY was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
